name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Maze Game
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a combination of high-quality wood and durable acrylic, offering a fun, sturdy, and eye-catching finish.
    - Features a 3-layer construction that creates a secure and interactive maze game design.
    - Layer 1: Wooden with a 5mm thickness and 2-sided printing, providing a solid back structure.
    - Layer 2: Wooden with a 5mm thickness and 1-sided printing, forming the maze path and inner game layer.
    - Layer 3: Acrylic with a 3mm thickness and 1-sided printing, creating a clear protective front panel.
    - Includes 1 steel ball with Ø 4.5mm for smooth and fun gameplay.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
               +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
               +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology on wooden base for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1: Wooden – 2-sided printing
    - Layer 2: Wooden – 1-sided printing
    - Layer 3: Acrylic – 1-sided printing

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both an interactive maze game and a personalized keepsake toy.
    - Designed to help users guide the steel ball through the maze path for fun and engaging play.
    - Suitable for children’s playtime, family interaction, travel entertainment, and tabletop activities.
    - The compact design makes it easy to hold, carry, and store.
    - Perfect for combining entertainment, decoration, and personalized design in one playful product.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for kids, children, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, classroom gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for animal lovers, educational toy gifts, and custom keepsakes for children.
    - A thoughtful gift for playrooms, kids’ rooms, and fun family activity collections.
    - Great for party favors, reward gifts, and memorable personalized surprises.
    - Adds a fun, cute, and playful touch to every special moment🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 3-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Maze Game

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
